#include <vector>

using namespace std;

{
    ios_base::sync_with_stdio(false);

    long long p, k;
    cin >> p >> k;

    vector<char> used(p, 0);
    long long ans = 1;
    const long long MOD = 1000000007LL;

    int start = (k == 1) ? 0 : 1;
    for (int i = start; i < p; ++i)
    {
        if (used[i])
            continue;

        int j = i;
        do
        {
            used[j] = 1;
            j = static_cast<int>((j * k) % p);
        } while (j != i && j != 0);

        ans = (ans * p) % MOD;
    }

    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}
